name: vulocart
description: AI-native, API-first commerce engine for WordPress
author: VuloLabs

scripts.build:release: pnpm run version && pnpm run build:zip
scripts.build:zip: pnpm install && pnpm run readme && pnpm run build:project && pnpm run makepot && pnpm run makejson && pnpm run release
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:css && pnpm run lint:php
scripts.fix: pnpm run fix:js && pnpm run fix:css && pnpm run fix:php
scripts.env:create: NODE_OPTIONS='--no-network-family-autoselection' pnpm wp-env start && pnpm run env:start:database
scripts.env:start: NODE_OPTIONS='--no-network-family-autoselection' pnpm wp-env start && pnpm run env:start:database
scripts.env:dev: NODE_OPTIONS='--no-network-family-autoselection' pnpm wp-env start --update && pnpm run env:start:database && pnpm --if-present --filter storybook run watch:build:storybook
scripts.env:stop: NODE_OPTIONS='--no-network-family-autoselection' pnpm wp-env stop && docker compose down
scripts.makepot: pnpm exec wp i18n make-pot --domain='vulocart' --include='assets/js,classes,templates,modules,config.php,vulocart.php' . --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"https://vulolabs.com/contact/"}' --file-comment="Copyright (c) $(date +'%Y') VuloLabs Inc. All Rights Reserved." languages/vulocart.pot
scripts.makejson: pnpm exec wp i18n make-json languages --pretty-print --no-purge

build:project:bundle.command: wp-scripts build --progress && pnpm run minify && pnpm run move && pnpm run clean
